tweets.text:
Maintenance is over in #PokemonChampions, and version 1.1.5 is up! ⏫

Several currently undisclosed bugs have been fixed!

Let's go play the game again! 🛠️

🚨 Regulation Set M-B 🚨

Alongside the news of Season M-5, the current ruleset has been extended for one week, and will now finish on 9 September! 🗓️

It does not affect any currently announced tournaments 👍

🔗 All info:

Ranked Battles Season M-5 has already started, and will be up until 9 September! 🪜

🎮 Regulation Set M-B

⚠️ Champion Tier and Master Ball Tiers 1 to 3 will be unlocked on 12 August!

🔗 All 2027 events:

チャンピオン級🙆‍♂️
M-Bだいぶ感触良くなってきた

The Battle Pass for Season M-5 includes Chandelure and its Mega Stone, 48 Quick Coupons, 4 Teammate Tickets, 4 Training Tickets and up to 10,000 VP 🎁

The Premium Battle Pass adds Excadrill, Scrafty and their Mega Stones, as well as 6 Teammate Tickets and 9 Training Tickets 🎟️
